intro.title: Build websocket auth handshake
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a secure WebSocket authentication handshake for a Node.js server. You will learn how to verify a user's identity before allowing a WebSocket connection to be established. The core programming concept involves using HTTP headers to pass authentication tokens and validating them in a WebSocket upgrade request. You will work with the 'ws' library for WebSocket connections and Node.js HTTP modules to handle the handshake process. By the end, you'll have a server that only accepts connections from authenticated clients.
intro.usecase: WebSocket authentication handshakes are essential for securing real-time applications like collaborative document editors (Google Docs), live chat systems (Slack), and multiplayer gaming dashboards. When a user opens a trading platform dashboard or joins a video conferencing UI, this handshake validates their credentials before establishing the persistent connection. Developers implement this pattern to ensure only authorized users can access real-time data streams and interactive features, preventing unauthorized data exposure in financial, healthcare, or enterprise applications.
